Native / zero-offload / recovery Loop / recovery Token: observed request timeline

These are independent serving runs. Each row starts at the selected request's arrival. Bars are host enclosures, not GPU kernels. Blank space is unobserved GPU activity. Blue marks identify output delivery, not Decode kernel duration.

Orange: P submission-to-ready host enclosure. Green: D submission-to-observed-completion host enclosure. Purple: source commit-to-D receipt host interval. Native uses its observed Prefill-complete-to-D-receipt interval. Purple does not measure DMA alone. Red: first output. Shared batch enclosures can overlap. Do not add their durations. The initial view selects the first observed offloaded request, not the fastest request. All 128 requests remain selectable.
